verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken structure: the SOLSTICE wordmark is pushed below the headline, the badges fall below the CTA, and the green circle has come loose from the phone and sits under the 'Summer Only' badge at the bottom. A is worse: its headline is jammed against the left canvas edge (about 4px), the headline, wordmark and subtitle each start at a different left edge, and the full-bleed CTA reads cramped. B puts the headline, wordmark and subtitle on one left margin with a properly inset CTA, but its centred CTA and badges don't line up with that left-aligned text.
